title: Newly Established Cafe Equity Stake For Sale in Pune, India
tagline: Pre-operational, café in Pune is a lively space where art, theater, and dining come together for a unique experience. - Beyond food, we host theater performances that showcase local talent and engage the community. - The venue will be available for bookings, making it a popular choice for cultural events, performances, and gatherings. - We intend to offer creative workshops for those looking to explore their artistic side and learn new skills. - The diverse customer base includes artists, families, theatre groups, and anyone interested in cultural experiences. - Business focuses on a multi stream revenue model generating through café sales, venue rentals, performance tickets, workshops, and retail sales, ensuring a steady flow of income. - With a projected sales of INR 20 Lac per month at 20% EBIDTA margins. - The business will commence in a couple of months, and the interest payment will be made through the businesses earned revenue and incase required the owner will take the full responsibility to repay it through their personal funds. - The Business facility construction is almost completed and will be fully constructed within another 45 days i. e. 1 and a half month and the business can start its operations. - We require a buffer time of approximately 3 months once the business commences to get acquainted and start the interest payments.
